pairs: if you have risen together with Christ,
seek the things that are above,
ubi Christus est in dextera Dei sedens:
where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
Consider the things that are above,
not the things that are upon the earth.
et vita vestra est abscondita cum Christo in Deo.
and so your life is hidden with Christ in God.
et vos apparebitis cum ipso in gloria.
then you also will appear with him in glory.

which are a kind of service to idols,
propter quæ venit ira Dei super filios incredulitatis:
the wrath of God has overwhelmed the sons of unbelief.
in quibus et vos ambulastis aliquando, cum viveretis in illis.
You, too, walked in these things, in times past, when you were living among them.
Nunc autem deponite et vos omnia:
But now you must set aside all these things:
and indecent speech from your mouth.
Do not lie to one another.
expoliantes vos veterem hominem cum actibus suis,
Strip yourselves of the old man, with his deeds,
and clothe yourself with the new man,
qui renovatur in agnitionem secundum imaginem ejus qui creavit illum:
who has been renewed by knowledge, in accord with the image of the One who created him,
ubi non est gentilis et Judæus,
where there is neither Gentile nor Jew,
clothe yourselves like the elect of God:
et donantes vobismetipsis si quis adversus aliquem habet querelam:
if anyone has a complaint against another,
For just as the Lord has forgiven you,
Super omnia autem hæc, caritatem habete,
And above all these things have charity,
which is the bond of perfection.
et pax Christi exsultet in cordibus vestris,
And let the peace of Christ lift up your hearts.
in qua et vocati estis in uno corpore:
For in this peace, you have been called, as one body.
Verbum Christi habitet in vobis abundanter,
Let the word of Christ live in you in abundance,
in gratia cantantes in cordibus vestris Deo.
singing to God with the grace in your hearts.
Let everything whatsoever that you do,
quodcumque facitis in verbo aut in opere,
whether in word or in deed,
omnia in nomine Domini Jesu Christi,
be done all in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ,
gratias agentes Deo et Patri per ipsum.
giving thanks to God the Father through him.
Wives, be submissive to your husbands,
as is proper in the Lord.
et nolite amari esse ad illas.
and do not be bitter toward them.
obey your parents in all things.
hoc enim placitum est in Domino.
For this is well-pleasing to the Lord.
nolite ad indignationem provocare filios vestros,
do not provoke your children to indignation,
obey, in all things, your lords according to the flesh,
quasi hominibus placentes, sed in simplicitate cordis,
as if to please men, but serving in simplicity of heart,
do it from the heart, as for the Lord,
scientes quod a Domino accipietis retributionem hæreditatis.
For you know that you will receive from the Lord the repayment of an inheritance.
Qui enim injuriam facit, recipiet id quod inique gessit:
For whoever causes injury shall be repaid for what he has wrongfully done.
et non est personarum acceptio apud Deum.
And there no favoritism with God.
